name: bitgalaxy-shell
description: BitGalaxy Shell Connector：本机 SSH 数据面 Agent（M1 直连 + 内嵌工作台，设计稿 docs/shell-design.md）

scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:ui
scripts.build:node: npm run build -w @bgshell/protocol && npm run build -w @bgshell/connector-core && npm run build -w @bgshell/transport-ws && npm run build -w @bgshell/transport-mcp && npm run build -w @bgshell/agent
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:exe && npm run desktop:prep && npm run pet:prep && npm run dev -w @bgshell/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build:exe && npm run desktop:prep && npm run pet:prep && npm run build -w @bgshell/desktop
